name: MOS rating
pick: A listening test: people hear each clip (for example from several speech or TTS systems) and rate it on a scale, like MOS naturalness or quality from 1 to 5.
summary: Listen to clips and rate how natural they sound, from 1 to 5.
suggest: Rate audio quality instead of naturalness
Also ask how easy it is to understand

examples.question: How good is the quality of this recording?

examples.secondQuestion: How easy is it to understand?

settings.title: How natural does it sound?
settings.instructions: Put on headphones and find a quiet place. You will hear short recordings, one at a time. Listen to each to the end, then rate how natural the voice sounds: 1 means clearly artificial, 5 means just like a real person speaking.
settings.question: How natural does the voice sound?
